ui.season_ends_in_complete_tasks_to_earn.en: Season ends in {arg1}. Complete tasks to earn points and unlock tiers.

ui.send_me_notifications_off_until_you_t.text: 傳送通知給我（開啟前為關閉）

ui.send_warriors_in_through_a_glowing_in.en: Send warriors in through a glowing infiltration point.

ui.sends_what_you_do_in_the_game_session.en: Sends what you do in the game (sessions, tutorial steps, raids, upgrades, offers seen and purchases, with their numbers) under a random statistics id, never your name, Player ID, village, chat or IP address, so we can see where players get stuck. Turning it on also sends what this device recorded so far; turning it off deletes what was sent.
ui.sends_what_you_do_in_the_game_session.text: 以隨機的統計 ID 傳送你在遊戲中做的事（遊玩階段、教學步驟、突襲、升級、看到的優惠和購買，以及相關數字），絕不包含你的名稱、玩家 ID、村莊、聊天或 IP 位址，讓我們了解玩家在哪裡卡住。開啟後也會傳送這台裝置目前為止的紀錄；關閉則會刪除已傳送的內容。

ui.settle_the_score_simulated_raider_no_.en: Settle the score · simulated raider · no honor moves
ui.settle_the_score_simulated_raider_no_.text: 雪恥 · 模擬突襲者 · 榮譽不會變動

ui.share_play_statistics_off_until_you_t.en: Share play statistics (off until you turn it on)
ui.share_play_statistics_off_until_you_t.text: 分享遊玩統計（開啟前為關閉）

ui.shield_no_raids_until_it_runs_out_667.en: Shield: no raids until it runs out

ui.shield_removed_raiders_can_now_find_y.en: Shield removed. Raiders can now find your village while you are away.
ui.shield_removed_raiders_can_now_find_y.text: 護盾已移除。你不在時，突襲者現在能找到你的村莊。

ui.show_unlocked_or_all_warriors_3f4ca5e.text: 顯示已解鎖或全部戰士

ui.sign_ins_play_this_account_on_other_d.en: Sign-ins (play this account on other devices)

ui.sized_for_your_clan_keep_level_69566e.en: Sized for your Clan Keep level {arg1}.
ui.sized_for_your_clan_keep_level_69566e.text: 依你的天守閣等級 {arg1} 調整。

ui.sized_for_your_clan_keep_level_won_at.en: Sized for your Clan Keep level {arg1}. Won attacks also earn the league bonus (all of it at 3 stars, a third per star).
ui.sized_for_your_clan_keep_level_won_at.text: 依你的天守閣等級 {arg1} 調整。進攻勝利還能拿到聯賽加成（3 顆星全拿，每顆星三分之一）。

ui.some_of_what_this_chest_can_hold_may_.en: Some of what this chest can hold may not fit in your storage, and anything that does not fit is lost. Spend or collect some resources first, or open it anyway.
ui.some_of_what_this_chest_can_hold_may_.text: 這個寶箱裡的部分東西可能放不進你的倉庫，放不下的會損失。先花掉或收集一些資源，或者仍要開啟。

ui.something_went_wrong_starting_the_gam.en: Something went wrong starting the game.

ui.space_taken_in_the_squad_courtyards_1.en: Space taken in the Squad Courtyards
ui.space_taken_in_the_squad_courtyards_1.text: 集結庭院中已用的空間

ui.start_a_new_village_on_the_server_28d.en: Start a new village on the server?

ui.start_a_village_on_the_server_b47dac6.en: Start a village on the server

ui.start_from_half_the_damage_your_gang_.en: Start from half the damage your Gang last did
ui.start_from_half_the_damage_your_gang_.text: 從你幫派上次傷害的一半開始

ui.stuck_on_tier_you_can_switch_it_to_a_.en: Stuck on tier {arg1}? You can switch it to a different fortress of the same strength and reward ({arg2} switches left for this tier, one after each failed attempt).
ui.stuck_on_tier_you_can_switch_it_to_a_.text: 卡在第 {arg1} 層了嗎？你可以換成另一座強度和獎勵相同的要塞（這一層還能換 {arg2} 次，每次失敗後可換一次）。

ui.suggest_a_break_after_an_hour_of_play.en: Suggest a break after an hour of play

ui.switching_servers_restarts_the_game_y.en: Switching servers restarts the game. Your village stays on this device either way.
ui.switching_servers_restarts_the_game_y.text: 切換伺服器會重新啟動遊戲。無論如何，你的村莊都會留在這台裝置上。

ui.tactic_send_saboteurs_first_to_jam_de.en: Tactic: send Saboteurs first to jam defenses, then the main force; throw smoke over your warriors as they walk into tower range.
ui.tactic_send_saboteurs_first_to_jam_de.text: 戰術：先派破壞者干擾防禦設施，再派主力；在戰士走進塔的射程時丟煙霧。

ui.tap_inside_a_glowing_ring_to_send_you.en: Tap inside a glowing ring to send your warriors in. Arrows at the edge lead to more rings.
ui.tap_inside_a_glowing_ring_to_send_you.text: 點一下發光的圓圈內，派戰士進去。邊緣的箭頭指向更多圓圈。

ui.tap_on_the_grass_outside_the_red_area.en: Tap on the grass outside the red area to send your warriors in.
ui.tap_on_the_grass_outside_the_red_area.text: 點一下紅色區域外的草地，派戰士進去。

ui.tap_update_to_get_the_newest_version_.en: Tap Update to get the newest version. You can also copy a save code to open the village on another device.
ui.tap_update_to_get_the_newest_version_.text: 點「更新」取得最新版本。你也可以複製存檔代碼，在另一台裝置上開啟村莊。

ui.tap_where_your_warriors_are_about_to_.en: Tap where your warriors are about to come under fire: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
ui.tap_where_your_warriors_are_about_to_.text: 點一下戰士即將遭到攻擊的地方：煙霧裡的戰士只會被近距離射中。

ui.tell_the_moderators_what_did_0abde973.text: 告訴管理員 {arg1} 做了什麼。

ui.testing_sandbox_a_separate_practice_v.en: Testing sandbox: a separate practice village with testing tools and a free test store. Your real village is untouched, and online play is off.
ui.testing_sandbox_a_separate_practice_v.text: 測試沙盒：一座獨立的練習村莊，附有測試工具和免費的測試商店。你真正的村莊不受影響，線上遊戲也是關閉的。

ui.texture_preparation_failed_the_scenes.en: Texture preparation failed; the scenes paint what is missing
ui.texture_preparation_failed_the_scenes.text: 材質準備失敗；場景會自行繪製缺少的部分

ui.thank_you_you_can_turn_this_off_in_se.en: Thank you. You can turn this off in Settings.
ui.thank_you_you_can_turn_this_off_in_se.text: 謝謝。你可以在設定中關閉這項功能。

ui.thank_you_your_purchase_has_been_deli.en: Thank you! Your purchase has been delivered.

ui.thanks_the_moderators_will_look_at_it.en: Thanks. The moderators will look at it.

ui.that_did_not_work_try_again_d38eba7d0.en: That did not work. Try again.

ui.that_path_is_full_each_point_hides_sp.en: That path is full: each point hides {arg1} space of warriors. Use another point.
ui.that_path_is_full_each_point_hides_sp.text: 那條路已滿：每個點只能藏 {arg1} 空間的戰士。請用另一個點。

ui.that_ring_is_full_send_the_rest_throu.en: That ring is full. Send the rest through another glowing ring.
ui.that_ring_is_full_send_the_rest_throu.text: 那個圓圈已滿。把其餘戰士從另一個發光圓圈派進去。

ui.that_village_could_not_be_restored_da.en: That village could not be restored.

ui.the_duel_could_not_be_recorded_2b8c39.en: The duel could not be recorded: {arg1}

ui.the_full_list_of_keep_unlocks_is_on_t.en: The full list of Keep unlocks is on the Clan Keep: tap it, then "What the next level unlocks".
ui.the_full_list_of_keep_unlocks_is_on_t.text: 天守閣的完整解鎖清單在天守閣上：點它，再點「下一級解鎖的內容」。

ui.the_home_screen_app_keeps_its_own_vil.en: The Home Screen app keeps its own village, apart from Safari’s. To bring yours here: open Kagemura in Safari, go to Settings → Copy save code, then come back and use Settings → Load from code.
ui.the_home_screen_app_keeps_its_own_vil.text: 主畫面 App 會保留自己的村莊，與 Safari 的分開。要把你的村莊帶過來：在 Safari 開啟 Kagemura，前往「設定 → 複製存檔代碼」，再回來使用「設定 → 從代碼載入」。

ui.the_item_is_delivered_at_once_by_buyi.en: The item is delivered at once; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
ui.the_item_is_delivered_at_once_by_buyi.text: 項目會立即發放；購買即表示你同意依法律對數位內容的規定，放棄取消的權利。

ui.the_league_season_ended_your_chest_wa.en: The league season ended: your chest was added. See Honor for details.
ui.the_league_season_ended_your_chest_wa.text: 聯賽賽季結束了：你的寶箱已加入。詳情請看「榮譽」。

ui.the_new_version_could_not_be_download.en: The new version could not be downloaded right now. Check your connection and try again.
ui.the_new_version_could_not_be_download.text: 目前無法下載新版本。請檢查網路連線後再試一次。

ui.the_next_alliance_war_starts_in_and_l.en: The next Alliance War starts in {arg1} and lasts {arg2} days. Every member gets {arg3} attacks; the best stars on each enemy base add up, and the Alliance with more stars wins.
ui.the_next_alliance_war_starts_in_and_l.text: 下一場同盟戰在 {arg1}後開始，持續 {arg2} 天。每位成員有 {arg3} 次進攻；每個敵方基地上最好的星數會相加，星數較多的同盟獲勝。

ui.the_raider_held_this_rematch_is_used_.en: The raider held. This rematch is used up.
ui.the_raider_held_this_rematch_is_used_.text: 突襲者守住了。這次重戰已用掉。

ui.the_server_could_not_take_this_villag.en: The server could not take this village: {arg1}
ui.the_server_could_not_take_this_villag.text: 伺服器無法接收這座村莊：{arg1}

ui.the_server_did_not_accept_your_raid_o.en: The server did not accept your raid on {arg1}. It counts as practice: no loot or honor.{arg2}
ui.the_server_did_not_accept_your_raid_o.text: 伺服器沒有接受你對 {arg1} 的突襲。這次算作練習：沒有戰利品或榮譽。{arg2}

ui.the_squad_courtyards_are_spoken_for_t.en: The Squad Courtyards are spoken for: train ahead for the next army
ui.the_squad_courtyards_are_spoken_for_t.text: 集結庭院已經被占滿了：先替下一支軍隊預先訓練

ui.the_store_could_not_be_reached_for_pr.en: The store could not be reached for prices. Check your connection and open the Store again.
ui.the_store_could_not_be_reached_for_pr.text: 無法連上商店取得價格。請檢查網路連線後重新開啟商店。

ui.the_store_shows_the_final_price_inclu.en: The store shows the final price, including any taxes, before you pay.
ui.the_store_shows_the_final_price_inclu.text: 商店會在你付款前顯示含稅的最終價格。

ui.the_training_dojo_researches_a_higher.en: The Training Dojo researches {arg1} (a higher Clan Keep opens more research lanes). A new level makes every warrior of that kind stronger, and costs a little more to train. Your Clan Keep level sets the highest level.
ui.the_training_dojo_researches_a_higher.text: 修行道場可同時研究{arg1}（天守閣越高，研究線越多）。新等級會讓同類型的所有戰士變強，訓練費用也稍微提高。最高等級由天守閣等級決定。

ui.their_full_training_cost_comes_back_a.en: Their full training cost comes back, as far as your storage allows.
ui.their_full_training_cost_comes_back_a.text: 在倉庫容量允許下，全額退回他們的訓練費用。

ui.there_is_no_online_account_on_this_de.en: There is no online account on this device: your village is kept only here. "Start a new village" below erases it; uninstalling the app or clearing this site's data removes it completely.
ui.there_is_no_online_account_on_this_de.text: 這台裝置上沒有線上帳號：你的村莊只保存在這裡。下方的「開始新村莊」會清除它；解除安裝 App 或清除這個網站的資料會完全移除它。

ui.they_are_under_fire_pick_the_smoke_bo.en: They are under fire! Pick the Smoke Bomb, then tap on your warriors.
ui.they_are_under_fire_pick_the_smoke_bo.text: 他們遭到攻擊了！選擇煙霧彈，然後點一下你的戰士。

ui.they_fight_first_in_your_next_attack_.en: They fight first in your next attack and take no Courtyard space.
ui.they_fight_first_in_your_next_attack_.text: 他們會在你下一次進攻時先上場，而且不占庭院空間。

ui.they_go_home_for_good_you_get_back_of.en: They go home for good. You get back {arg1}% of their training cost, as far as your storage allows.
ui.they_go_home_for_good_you_get_back_of.text: 他們會永遠回家。在倉庫容量允許下，退回他們訓練費用的 {arg1}%。

ui.they_walk_in_by_themselves_after_a_ra.en: {arg1} They walk in by themselves after a raid, or when you dismiss warriors.
ui.they_walk_in_by_themselves_after_a_ra.text: {arg1} 他們會在突襲後或你遣散戰士時自己走進來。

ui.they_will_be_able_to_invite_and_to_st.en: They will be able to invite and to start Gang Wars. You stay in the Gang.
ui.they_will_be_able_to_invite_and_to_st.text: 對方將能邀請成員和發起幫派戰。你會留在幫派裡。

ui.this_browser_can_t_save_your_village_.en: This browser can't save your village: progress is lost when this page closes. Use a normal (not private) window, or copy a save code in Settings.
ui.this_browser_can_t_save_your_village_.text: 這個瀏覽器無法儲存你的村莊：關閉這個頁面後進度就會消失。請使用一般（非無痕）視窗，或在設定中複製存檔代碼。

ui.this_browser_may_delete_this_village_.en: This browser may delete this village if you stay away for a while. To keep it: install Kagemura (the browser menu → Install app or Add to Home screen), link a sign-in under Online play, or copy a save code.
ui.this_browser_may_delete_this_village_.text: 如果你一段時間沒來，這個瀏覽器可能會刪除這座村莊。要保留它：安裝 Kagemura（瀏覽器選單 → 安裝應用程式或加入主畫面）、在「線上遊戲」連結登入方式，或複製存檔代碼。

ui.this_browser_may_delete_your_village_.en: This browser may delete your village if you stay away for a week.
ui.this_browser_may_delete_your_village_.text: 如果你一週沒來，這個瀏覽器可能會刪除你的村莊。

ui.this_browser_mode_cannot_save_your_vi.en: This browser mode cannot save. Your village will be lost when you close the page.
ui.this_browser_mode_cannot_save_your_vi.text: 這個瀏覽器模式無法儲存。關閉頁面後你的村莊就會消失。

ui.this_device_could_not_store_your_late.en: This device could not store your latest actions (storage full or blocked). They are being sent to the server now; free some space to keep playing offline safely.
ui.this_device_could_not_store_your_late.text: 這台裝置無法儲存你最近的操作（儲存空間已滿或被封鎖）。現在正送往伺服器；請釋放一些空間，才能安全地離線遊玩。

ui.this_device_still_holds_your_online_a.en: This device still holds your online account on
ui.this_device_still_holds_your_online_a.text: 這台裝置仍保有你在以下伺服器的線上帳號：

ui.this_device_will_play_the_account_lin.en: This device will play the account linked to that sign-in. If its village is kept on the server, it replaces the village here, which stays as a backup in Settings. Your current online account is not deleted.
ui.this_device_will_play_the_account_lin.text: 這台裝置會玩那個登入方式所連結的帳號。如果它的村莊保存在伺服器上，會取代這裡的村莊，這裡的村莊則在設定中保留為備份。你目前的線上帳號不會被刪除。

ui.this_is_a_server_for_testing_villages.en: This is a {arg1} server for testing: villages and purchases here are separate from the real game.
ui.this_is_a_server_for_testing_villages.text: 這是用於測試的 {arg1} 伺服器：這裡的村莊和購買與正式遊戲分開。

ui.this_is_the_testing_sandbox_a_separat.en: This is the testing sandbox: a separate practice village with online play off. Skipping time moves the sandbox clock ahead for good; your real village is never affected.
ui.this_is_the_testing_sandbox_a_separat.text: 這是測試沙盒：一座關閉線上遊戲的獨立練習村莊。跳過時間會讓沙盒時鐘永久往前；你真正的村莊絕不受影響。

ui.this_starts_a_new_village_that_is_kep.en: This starts a new village that is kept on the server. The village on this device stays as a backup you can restore in Settings.
ui.this_starts_a_new_village_that_is_kep.text: 這會開始一座保存在伺服器上的新村莊。這台裝置上的村莊會保留為備份，可在設定中恢復。

ui.time_skips_and_test_purchases_live_in.en: Time skips and test purchases live in a separate testing sandbox, so they can never change your real village or online play.
ui.time_skips_and_test_purchases_live_in.text: 時間跳躍和測試購買只存在於獨立的測試沙盒中，所以絕不會改變你真正的村莊或線上遊戲。

ui.time_until_everyone_who_fits_in_the_s.en: Time until everyone who fits in the Squad Courtyards has finished
ui.time_until_everyone_who_fits_in_the_s.text: 直到所有能放進集結庭院的戰士都完成訓練的時間

ui.train_some_warriors_first_duels_use_y.en: Train some warriors first: duels use your army (none are spent).
ui.train_some_warriors_first_duels_use_y.text: 請先訓練一些戰士：切磋會使用你的軍隊（不會消耗）。

ui.train_some_warriors_then_save_the_mix.en: Train some warriors, then save the mix here to refill it later.
ui.train_some_warriors_then_save_the_mix.text: 先訓練一些戰士，再把這個組合儲存在這裡，之後就能補滿。

ui.trained_ahead_they_join_your_army_whe.en: Trained ahead. They join your army when the Squad Courtyards have room. Jade can't finish them until then.
ui.trained_ahead_they_join_your_army_whe.text: 已預先訓練。集結庭院有空間時他們就會加入軍隊。在那之前無法用翡翠完成。

ui.training_opens_as_soon_as_the_work_is.en: Training opens as soon as the work is done.
ui.training_opens_as_soon_as_the_work_is.text: 工程一完成就能開始訓練。

ui.troop_research_up_to_level_now_fe9cb9.text: 戰士研究：最高 {arg1} 級（目前 {arg2}）

ui.two_to_four_friends_against_another_g.en: Two to four friends against another Gang of the same size: 2 hours to prepare, then 22 hours with 2 attacks each. Strike alone, or relay: a relay strike starts from half the damage of your Gang’s last strike on that base (defenders patch up in between). No honor is won or lost; everyone gets a chest.
ui.two_to_four_friends_against_another_g.text: 兩到四位好友對上另一個同樣規模的幫派：準備 2 小時，接著 22 小時內每人進攻 2 次。可以單獨進攻，或接力：接力進攻會從你幫派上次對那個基地造成的傷害的一半開始（守方在中間會修補）。不會贏得或失去榮譽；每個人都能拿到寶箱。

ui.until_the_season_ends_20_faster_build.en: Until the season ends: {pct}% faster builds, the {arg1} look and bigger rewards on every tier. Rewards you already earned unlock right away.
ui.until_the_season_ends_20_faster_build.text: 直到賽季結束：建造加快 {pct}%、{arg1}外觀，以及每一階更多的獎勵。已經獲得的獎勵會立即解鎖。

ui.update_kagemura_from_then_open_it_aga.en: Update Kagemura from {arg1}, then open it again.
ui.update_kagemura_from_then_open_it_aga.text: 從 {arg1} 更新 Kagemura，然後再開啟一次。

ui.upgrading_your_clan_keep_to_level_unl.en: Upgrading your Clan Keep to level {arg1} unlocks:
ui.upgrading_your_clan_keep_to_level_unl.text: 把天守閣升到 {arg1} 級會解鎖：

ui.village_map_drag_to_look_around_pinch.en: Village map. Drag to look around, pinch or scroll to zoom, tap a building to select it. Every action is also on the buttons around the map.
ui.village_map_drag_to_look_around_pinch.text: 村莊地圖。拖曳來四處查看，雙指縮放或捲動來縮放，點一下建築來選取。每個操作在地圖周圍的按鈕上也都有。

ui.village_on_the_server_beta_b06787518d.text: 伺服器上的村莊（測試版）

ui.warrior_codex_all_classes_03eb859e9c.text: 戰士圖鑑：全部 {arg1} 種兵種

ui.warriors_need_two_buildings_the_dojo_.en: Warriors need two buildings: the Dojo trains them and the Courtyard houses them.
ui.warriors_need_two_buildings_the_dojo_.text: 戰士需要兩座建築：道場訓練他們，庭院容納他們。

ui.we_keep_only_an_age_group_on_this_dev.en: We keep only an age group on this device and our server, never your date of birth. Please answer honestly: our support team can correct a mistake.
ui.we_keep_only_an_age_group_on_this_dev.text: 我們在這台裝置和伺服器上只保留年齡層，絕不保留你的生日。請誠實回答：如有錯誤，我們的客服團隊可以更正。

ui.what_keep_lv_unlocks_ced96de6b4.text: 天守閣 {arg1} 級解鎖的內容

ui.when_the_game_hits_an_error_it_sends_.en: When the game hits an error, it sends the error message, where in the code it happened, the game version and the platform, to help fix it. It does not add your name, Player ID, village or chat, but an error message can sometimes include text the game was working on.
ui.when_the_game_hits_an_error_it_sends_.text: 遊戲發生錯誤時，會傳送錯誤訊息、出錯的程式碼位置、遊戲版本和平台，協助修正問題。它不會加入你的名稱、玩家 ID、村莊或聊天，但錯誤訊息有時可能包含遊戲正在處理的文字。

ui.when_the_last_of_this_stack_finishes_.en: When the last of this stack finishes, after everyone ahead of it
ui.when_the_last_of_this_stack_finishes_.text: 這一疊的最後一名完成時，排在前面的都完成之後

ui.where_you_live_google_play_confirms_a.en: Where you live, Google Play confirms ages for apps. Open the Play Store app, verify your age there, then come back: online play and purchases unlock once Google Play shares your age group.
ui.where_you_live_google_play_confirms_a.text: 在你所在的地區，Google Play 會確認 App 使用者的年齡。請開啟 Play 商店 App 驗證年齡後再回來：Google Play 分享你的年齡層後，線上遊戲和購買就會解鎖。

ui.where_you_live_the_app_store_confirms.en: Where you live, the App Store confirms ages for apps. Confirm your age in your Apple Account settings, then come back.
ui.where_you_live_the_app_store_confirms.text: 在你所在的地區，App Store 會確認 App 使用者的年齡。請在 Apple 帳號設定中確認年齡後再回來。

ui.who_can_find_me_by_name_64ffa21978.en: Who can find me by name

ui.who_can_find_me_by_name_ed481ead6d.en: Who can find me by name

ui.win_raids_to_earn_honor_lose_it_when_.en: Win raids to earn honor; lose it when your attacks fail or when raiders beat your village. More honor bring tougher opponents with more loot.
ui.win_raids_to_earn_honor_lose_it_when_.text: 贏得突襲就能獲得榮譽；進攻失敗或突襲者打敗你的村莊時會失去。榮譽越高，對手越強，戰利品也越多。

ui.you_are_about_to_spend_of_real_money_.en: You are about to spend {arg1} of real money. Make sure a parent or guardian says it's OK.
ui.you_are_about_to_spend_of_real_money_.text: 你即將花費 {arg1} 真實金錢。請確認家長或監護人同意。

ui.you_are_in_the_top_league_8b390ac669.en: You are in the top league!

ui.you_are_playing_on_your_own_opponents.en: You are playing on your own: opponents, raiders and your Alliance are friendly bots (always labelled as computer players). To raid real players and join real Alliances, enter a Kagemura: Ninja Clans server address under Advanced, below.
ui.you_are_playing_on_your_own_opponents.text: 你正在獨自遊玩：對手、突襲者和你的同盟都是友善的機器人（一律標示為電腦玩家）。要突襲真人玩家並加入真正的同盟，請在下方「進階」輸入 Kagemura: Ninja Clans 伺服器位址。

ui.you_can_add_each_other_again_later_01.en: You can add each other again later.
ui.you_can_add_each_other_again_later_01.text: 之後你們還可以再互加好友。

ui.you_can_found_or_join_a_gang_again_af.en: You can found or join a Gang again after 24 hours.
ui.you_can_found_or_join_a_gang_again_af.text: 24 小時後你可以再次創立或加入幫派。

ui.you_can_join_another_alliance_straigh.en: You can join another Alliance straight away. Warriors in your Alliance Lodge stay with you.
ui.you_can_join_another_alliance_straigh.text: 你可以馬上加入另一個同盟。同盟會館裡的戰士會留在你身邊。

ui.you_can_keep_saved_armies_delete_one_.en: You can keep {arg1} saved armies. Delete one to save this army.
ui.you_can_keep_saved_armies_delete_one_.text: 你最多可以保存 {arg1} 支軍隊。刪除一支來儲存這支軍隊。

ui.you_finished_the_training_please_ente.en: You finished the training. Please enter your year of birth: it sets the right protections for your age (spending limits, offers, and for online play who can find you and how you chat).
ui.you_finished_the_training_please_ente.text: 你完成了訓練。請輸入你的出生年份：這會依你的年齡設定合適的保護措施（消費上限、優惠，以及線上遊戲中誰能找到你和你的聊天方式）。

ui.you_have_not_cleared_a_tier_yet_cb231.en: You have not cleared a tier yet.
ui.you_have_not_cleared_a_tier_yet_cb231.text: 你還沒有通過任何一層。

ui.you_have_the_premium_season_scroll_th.en: You have the premium Season Scroll this season.
ui.you_have_the_premium_season_scroll_th.text: 本賽季你有進階賽季卷軸。

ui.you_joined_after_this_war_started_che.en: You joined after this war started: cheer your Gang on.
ui.you_joined_after_this_war_started_che.text: 你是在這場戰爭開始後才加入的：為你的幫派加油吧。

ui.you_left_a_gang_lately_you_can_found_.en: You left a Gang lately: you can found or join one in {arg1}.
ui.you_left_a_gang_lately_you_can_found_.text: 你最近離開了幫派：{arg1}後才能創立或加入幫派。

ui.you_ll_get_back_of_what_you_paid_5919.en: You'll get back {arg1}% of what you paid.

ui.you_stop_being_friends_and_neither_of.en: You stop being friends, and neither of you can find or ask the other.
ui.you_stop_being_friends_and_neither_of.text: 你們將不再是好友，彼此也都無法再找到或邀請對方。

ui.your_age_group_can_only_be_made_stric.en: Your age group can only be made stricter here. To correct it, contact support from Settings → Privacy and help.
ui.your_age_group_can_only_be_made_stric.text: 在這裡只能把年齡層調得更嚴格。若要更正，請從「設定 → 隱私權與說明」聯絡客服。

ui.your_alliance_is_matched_with_a_real_.en: Your Alliance is matched with a real Alliance of similar size and strength, or with a band of wild bots when none is free. Only members who were in the Alliance when the raid starts take part.
ui.your_alliance_is_matched_with_a_real_.text: 你的同盟會與規模和實力相近的真實同盟配對，沒有空的同盟時則對上一群野生機器人。只有突襲開始時已在同盟中的成員才會參與。

ui.your_alliance_level_xp_4f21dec979.text: {arg1}{arg2} {arg3} · 你的同盟等級 {arg4}（{arg5} 經驗值）{arg6}

ui.your_clan_keep_is_at_the_highest_leve.en: Your Clan Keep is at the highest level available right now.
ui.your_clan_keep_is_at_the_highest_leve.text: 你的天守閣已是目前可達的最高等級。

ui.your_current_layout_is_now_your_duel_.en: Your current layout is now your duel layout.
ui.your_current_layout_is_now_your_duel_.text: 你目前的布局現在是你的切磋布局。

ui.your_current_village_on_this_device_w.en: Your current village on this device will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
ui.your_current_village_on_this_device_w.text: 你在這台裝置上目前的村莊會被刪除。這無法復原。

ui.your_earlier_village_is_back_the_one_.en: Your earlier village is back. The one you were playing is kept in Settings.
ui.your_earlier_village_is_back_the_one_.text: 你先前的村莊回來了。你剛才玩的那座保留在設定中。

ui.your_first_raid_tap_attack_when_you_a.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack! when you are ready.
ui.your_first_raid_tap_attack_when_you_a.text: 你的第一次突襲。準備好了就點「進攻！」。

ui.your_friend_code_always_works_share_i.en: Your friend code always works: share it only with people you want to add.
ui.your_friend_code_always_works_share_i.text: 你的好友代碼永遠有效：只分享給你想加的人。

ui.your_leader_starts_gang_wars_fe4ca360.text: 幫派戰由你的首領發起。

ui.your_name_in_online_play_b1f7873e6c.text: 你在線上遊戲中的名稱

ui.your_new_village_is_kept_on_the_serve.en: Your new village is kept on the server.
ui.your_new_village_is_kept_on_the_serve.text: 你的新村莊保存在伺服器上。

ui.your_on_was_interrupted_and_has_been_.en: Your {arg1} on {arg2} was interrupted and has been played out: {arg3}★, {arg4}%. See the battle log.
ui.your_on_was_interrupted_and_has_been_.text: 你對 {arg2} 的{arg1}被中斷，已由系統打完：{arg3}★，{arg4}%。請查看戰鬥紀錄。

ui.your_online_account_was_deleted_a49f2.text: 你的線上帳號已被刪除。

ui.your_online_account_was_deleted_resta.en: Your online account was deleted. Restarting offline…
ui.your_online_account_was_deleted_resta.text: 你的線上帳號已被刪除。正在以離線模式重新啟動……

ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.en: Your player name, shared base, Alliance membership, chat messages and warrior requests are deleted from the server now. Online attacks still waiting for the server become practice results. Online play turns off on this device; your village stays. This cannot be undone.
ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.text: 你的玩家名稱、分享的基地、同盟成員身分、聊天訊息和戰士請求現在會從伺服器刪除。仍在等待伺服器的線上進攻會變成練習結果。這台裝置的線上遊戲會關閉；你的村莊會保留。這無法復原。

ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.en: Your player name, shared base, Alliance and Gang membership, friends, chat messages and any village kept on {arg1} are deleted from that server now. Online play stays off; your village on this device stays. This cannot be undone.
ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.text: 你的玩家名稱、分享的基地、同盟與幫派成員身分、好友、聊天訊息，以及保存在 {arg1} 上的村莊，現在會從那台伺服器刪除。線上遊戲維持關閉；這台裝置上的村莊會保留。這無法復原。

ui.your_purchase_is_here_but_this_device.en: Your purchase is here, but this device could not save it (storage full?). Free some space: it stays open in the store and is delivered again if needed.
ui.your_purchase_is_here_but_this_device.text: 你的購買已送達，但這台裝置無法儲存（儲存空間已滿？）。請釋放一些空間：它在商店中仍保持未完成，必要時會再次發放。

ui.your_remaining_troops_go_back_home_yo.en: Your remaining warriors go back home. You keep any loot you already won.
ui.your_remaining_troops_go_back_home_yo.text: 剩下的戰士會回家。已經贏得的戰利品會保留。

ui.your_stars_count_toward_the_alliance_.en: Your stars count toward the Alliance War.
ui.your_stars_count_toward_the_alliance_.text: 你的星星會計入同盟戰。

ui.your_training_dojo_trains_faster_than.en: Your Training Dojo trains {arg1}× faster than a level 1 Dojo.
ui.your_training_dojo_trains_faster_than.text: 你的修行道場訓練速度是 1 級道場的 {arg1}×。

ui.your_village_could_not_be_saved_free_.en: Your village could not be saved ({arg1}). Free some device storage, and copy a save code in Settings to keep it safe.
ui.your_village_could_not_be_saved_free_.text: 無法儲存你的村莊（{arg1}）。請釋放一些裝置空間，並在設定中複製存檔代碼以策安全。

ui.your_village_is_kept_on_the_server_ev.en: Your village is kept on the server: every change to its resources, buildings, army and research is checked there, so it cannot be lost with this device. What you do is sent as you play; while offline it waits and goes when you reconnect.
ui.your_village_is_kept_on_the_server_ev.text: 你的村莊保存在伺服器上：資源、建築、軍隊和研究的每一次變更都會在那裡檢查，所以不會隨著這台裝置遺失。你的操作會在遊玩時送出；離線時會等待，重新連線後再送。

ui.your_village_is_now_kept_on_the_serve.en: Your village is now kept on the server.
ui.your_village_is_now_kept_on_the_serve.text: 你的村莊現在保存在伺服器上。

ui.your_village_is_on_the_server_now_cou.en: Your village is on the server now. {arg1} could not be matched to a purchase we checked, so it is held for review: contact support from Settings. Your old village is kept as a backup.
ui.your_village_is_on_the_server_now_cou.text: 你的村莊現在在伺服器上了。{arg1} 無法對應到我們核對過的購買，所以暫時保留待審：請從設定聯絡客服。你的舊村莊保留為備份。

ui.your_village_is_saved_and_your_artisa.en: Your village is saved, and your Artisans keep working while you are away.
ui.your_village_is_saved_and_your_artisa.text: 你的村莊已儲存，你不在時工匠也會繼續工作。

ui.your_village_moves_to_the_server_as_i.en: Your village moves to the server as it is, if it is a village its Keep could really have. From then on every change is checked there, and you can play it on other devices by linking a sign-in.
ui.your_village_moves_to_the_server_as_i.text: 如果你的村莊是它的天守閣真的可能擁有的樣子，它就會原樣移到伺服器。之後每一次變更都會在那裡檢查，連結登入方式後就能在其他裝置上遊玩。

ui.your_village_saves_automatically_on_t.en: Your village saves automatically on this device. To move it to another device, copy a save code here and load it there.
ui.your_village_saves_automatically_on_t.text: 你的村莊會自動儲存在這台裝置上。要搬到另一台裝置，在這裡複製存檔代碼，再到那裡載入。

ui.your_village_was_opened_in_another_ta.en: Your village was opened in another tab or window, and only one can save it. Your progress is safe there.
ui.your_village_was_opened_in_another_ta.text: 你的村莊在另一個分頁或視窗中開啟了，而只有一處能儲存。你的進度在那裡很安全。

ui.your_village_was_saved_by_a_newer_ver.en: Your village was saved by a newer version of Kagemura, so this version cannot open it. It is safe and unchanged.
ui.your_village_was_saved_by_a_newer_ver.text: 你的村莊是由較新版本的 Kagemura 儲存的，所以這個版本無法開啟。它很安全，也沒有變動。

ui.your_war_base_now_matches_your_villag.en: Your war base now matches your village.
ui.your_war_base_now_matches_your_villag.text: 你的戰爭基地現在與村莊一致了。

extra.53d75daa54.text: 沒有空間可以放那座建築。

extra.a0ce7f563a.en: Towers in a wide ring cover each other: jam one, smoke your squad as it reaches the next, break in through the gap.
extra.a0ce7f563a.text: 寬闊環形排列的塔彼此掩護：干擾一座，在小隊接近下一座時放煙霧，從缺口突破。

srv.friend.requests_waiting.text: 你有很多請求在等待。等待回覆，或收回一些。

srv.friend.bad_provider.en: provider must be gamecenter or playgames.
srv.friend.bad_provider.text: provider 必須是 gamecenter 或 playgames。

srv.friend.link_first.en: Link {provider} to your account first (Settings → Online play → Sign-ins).
srv.friend.link_first.text: 請先將 {provider} 連結到你的帳號（設定 → 線上遊戲 → 登入方式）。

srv.friend.bad_findable.en: findable must be everyone, friends_of_friends or nobody.
srv.friend.bad_findable.text: findable 必須是 everyone、friends_of_friends 或 nobody。

srv.friend.under13_findable.en: Players under 13 can be found by friend code only.
srv.friend.under13_findable.text: 未滿 13 歲的玩家只能透過好友代碼找到。

srv.report.pick_reason.en: Pick a reason for the report.

srv.report.own_message.en: You cannot report your own message.
srv.report.own_message.text: 你不能檢舉自己的訊息。

srv.block.full.en: You have blocked as many players as you can. Unblock someone first.
srv.block.full.text: 你封鎖的玩家已達上限。請先解除封鎖某人。

srv.moderation.appeal.en: If you think this was a mistake, contact support from Settings → Privacy and help with your Player ID, and we will look again.
srv.moderation.appeal.text: 如果你認為這是誤判，請帶著玩家 ID 從「設定 → 隱私權與說明」聯絡客服，我們會再看一次。

srv.moderation.appeal_contact.en: If you think this was a mistake, write to {contact} with your Player ID (Settings → Online play → Account) and we will look again.
srv.moderation.appeal_contact.text: 如果你認為這是誤判，請附上玩家 ID（設定 → 線上遊戲 → 帳號）寫信到 {contact}，我們會再看一次。

srv.moderation.message_removed.en: A moderator removed your chat message.

srv.moderation.message_removed_quote.en: A moderator removed your chat message ("{quote}").

srv.moderation.chat_paused.en: A moderator paused your chat until {until}.

srv.moderation.chat_paused_removed.en: A moderator paused your chat until {until} and removed your message.

srv.moderation.chat_paused_removed_quote.en: A moderator paused your chat until {until} and removed your message ("{quote}").

srv.moderation.reviewed_message.en: Thanks, we reviewed your report about a chat message by {name}:

srv.moderation.reviewed_player.en: Thanks, we reviewed your report about {name}:

srv.moderation.outcome_none.en: we did not find a rule broken, so nothing was removed. Thank you for helping keep Kagemura friendly.
srv.moderation.outcome_none.text: 我們沒有發現違規，所以沒有刪除任何內容。謝謝你幫忙讓 Kagemura 保持友善。

srv.moderation.outcome_paused_removed.en: the player's chat was paused and the message removed.

srv.moderation.renamed.en: Your name was changed by a moderator because it broke the community rules. Reason: {reason}. You can choose a new name in Settings now.

srv.moderation.suspended.en: Your account is suspended from online play until {until}. Reason: {reason}.

srv.moderation.unsuspended.en: The suspension of your account has been lifted.

srv.account.apple_deleted.en: The Apple account linked to this game account was deleted, so Sign in with Apple was removed. This game account will be deleted after a short review. If you still play it, contact support from Settings → Privacy and help.

srv.account.consent_withdrawn.en: A parent or guardian withdrew consent for this game in the App Store, so online play is off for this account. To ask about it, contact support from Settings → Privacy and help.
srv.account.consent_withdrawn.text: 家長或監護人已在 App Store 撤回對這款遊戲的同意，因此這個帳號的線上遊戲已關閉。如有疑問，請從「設定 → 隱私權與說明」聯絡客服。

srv.account.enter_id.en: Enter your Player ID (Settings → Online play → Account).
srv.account.enter_id.text: 請輸入你的玩家 ID（設定 → 線上遊戲 → 帳號）。

srv.signin.update.en: This sign-in needs a newer version of Kagemura. Update the game and try again.

srv.signin.mismatch.en: The sign-in does not match this request. Try again.

srv.signin.used.en: This sign-in was already used or has expired. Try again.

srv.signin.taken.en: That sign-in already belongs to another player. Use "Sign in on this device" to switch to it.
srv.signin.taken.text: 那個登入方式已屬於另一位玩家。使用「在這台裝置上登入」切換過去。

srv.signin.already_linked.en: You already linked another account from that provider. Unlink it first.
srv.signin.already_linked.text: 你已經連結了該提供者的另一個帳號。請先解除連結。

srv.signin.first.en: Sign in on this device first.
srv.signin.first.text: 請先在這台裝置上登入。

srv.signin.only_key.en: This device holds the only key to this account. Link Apple, Google or Game Center first (then you can sign back in), or delete the account.

srv.signin.apple_off.en: Sign in with Apple is not set up on this server.
srv.signin.apple_off.text: 這台伺服器沒有設定透過 Apple 登入。

srv.signin.not_linked.en: No player is linked to that account yet. Link it from the device you play on first.
srv.signin.not_linked.text: 這個帳號還沒有連結任何玩家。請先從你玩遊戲的裝置連結。

srv.complaint.subject.en: Say what the complaint is about (a player name, an Alliance or Gang, a message).

srv.complaint.reason.en: Say why it is illegal or harmful (at least a sentence).

srv.complaint.contact.en: The contact must be an email address (or leave it empty).

srv.purchase.not_set_up.en: Purchases are not set up on this server yet. Nothing was charged.
srv.purchase.not_set_up.text: 這台伺服器還沒有設定購買。沒有收取任何費用。

srv.purchase.age_first.en: Please tell us your age group first.
srv.purchase.age_first.text: 請先告訴我們你的年齡層。

srv.purchase.paused_refunds.en: Purchases are paused on this account after several refunds. Contact support from Settings. Nothing was charged.
srv.purchase.paused_refunds.text: 這個帳號在多次退款後已暫停購買。請從設定聯絡客服。沒有收取任何費用。

srv.purchase.minor_cap.en: Monthly spending limit of ${limit} reached for players under 18. Nothing was charged.
srv.purchase.minor_cap.text: 已達到未滿 18 歲玩家的每月消費上限 ${limit}。沒有收取任何費用。

srv.purchase.over_cap_held.en: This purchase would go past the ${limit} monthly limit for players under 18, so it was not delivered. It stays with the store: it is delivered when next month's limit leaves room, or the store can refund it (Google Play refunds an undelivered purchase within 3 days).

srv.purchase.say_which.en: Say which purchase, and whether it was cancelled or is pending.
srv.purchase.say_which.text: 請說明是哪一筆購買，以及它是已取消還是待處理。

srv.purchase.not_sold.en: The game does not sell that product.
srv.purchase.not_sold.text: 遊戲沒有販售那個商品。

srv.purchase.other_player.en: This purchase belongs to another player.
srv.purchase.other_player.text: 這筆購買屬於另一位玩家。

srv.purchase.test_limited.en: Test purchases are limited on the live server.
srv.purchase.test_limited.text: 正式伺服器上的測試購買有限制。

srv.purchase.apple_off.en: App Store purchases are not set up on this server.
srv.purchase.apple_off.text: 這台伺服器沒有設定 App Store 購買。

srv.purchase.google_off.en: Google Play purchases are not set up on this server.
srv.purchase.google_off.text: 這台伺服器沒有設定 Google Play 購買。

srv.import.already.en: Your village is already kept on the server.
srv.import.already.text: 你的村莊已經保存在伺服器上了。

srv.import.unreadable.en: That village could not be read: {detail}

srv.import.sandbox.en: This village cannot move to the server: it was played in the testing sandbox (time skips and test purchases).
srv.import.sandbox.text: 這座村莊無法移到伺服器：它是在測試沙盒中遊玩的（時間跳躍和測試購買）。

srv.import.refused.en: This village cannot move to the server: {detail}
srv.import.refused.text: 這座村莊無法移到伺服器：{detail}

srv.import.too_new.en: A village at Keep {keep} can move to the server once this online account is {days} days old (in {wait, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}). It stays on this device meanwhile: keep playing, and the game tries again each day.
srv.import.too_new.text: 天守閣 {keep} 的村莊要等這個線上帳號滿 {days} 天才能移到伺服器（{wait, plural, other {還有 # 天}}）。在那之前村莊會留在這台裝置上：繼續玩吧，遊戲每天都會再試一次。
